crossRefs.note: “ ‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound…
Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look, and fail with longing for them all…
Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give…
For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the…
the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and…

translations.web: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
translations.bsb: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
translations.kjv: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
translations.asv: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.
